sources.title: Piracy monthly report January 2025
sources.text: Duty AB on routine rounds onboard an anchored tanker noticed two unlit boats near the bow and an unauthorised person on the forecastle deck. Alarm raised, ship’s horn sounded, crew mustered and moved towards the forecastle. Seeing the alerted crew, the person escaped with stolen stores.
